title: Fallback Chat Model with a Shared Contract Test
instructions: In `chat.py`, implement `FallbackChat` (an ordered composite of `ChatModel`s that falls back only on `ProviderError` and raises an `ExceptionGroup` when all fail) and `contract_violations(model)`, a reusable Liskov contract checker. The composite must pass the contract itself.

evidence.label: Returns the first success and does not call later models
Falls back on ProviderError and forwards max_tokens
Raises an ExceptionGroup containing every provider error
Non-ProviderError exceptions propagate without trying later models
An empty model list raises ValueError
Contract checker accepts compliant models (ProviderError is allowed)
Contract checker flags a model that rejects max_tokens the contract allows
Contract checker flags results that are not a Completion
